We undertake research across a broad range of electrical engineering fields with emphasis on future energy networks, wireless communications, computer engineering, software engineering, photonics and the Internet of Things.
Study with us
Create the next generation of technology for a brighter future. Explore our dedicated undergraduate and postgraduate courses spanning the areas of electrical and computer engineering.

What is electrical engineering?
H2
Electrical engineering is the dynamic field that drives innovation in electricity, electronics, and power systems. From designing advanced circuits and renewable energy solutions to creating the technology behind modern communication and automation, electrical engineers shape the future of how we power and connect our world.
What is software engineering?
H2
Software engineering is the discipline of designing, developing, testing, and maintaining complex software systems that power applications, businesses, and technologies across diverse industries.
